import json,csv,re,collections
V=[json.loads(l) for l in open('meetings-07-advanced.p01.verdicts.jsonl')]
rows={int(r['n']):r for r in csv.DictReader(open('meetings-07-advanced.p01.csv'))}
print("lines",len(V))
print("ns ok", sorted(v['n'] for v in V)==sorted(rows))

print("L8 with sop",[v['n'] for v in V if v['grade']=='L8' and v.get('sop')])
# structure check on sops: declared ids and referenced ids
bad=[]
for v in V:
    s=v.get('sop')
    if not s: continue
    ids=set(re.findall(r'^@([A-Za-z0-9_]+) ',s,re.M))
    refs=set(re.findall(r'\$([A-Za-z0-9_]+)',s))
    miss=refs-ids
    if miss: bad.append((v['n'],sorted(miss)))
print("dangling refs",bad)
# word coverage check
def words(t):
    return re.findall(r"[A-Za-z0-9:>\-'’\.]+", t.lower())
for v in V:
    s=v.get('sop')
    if not s: continue
    t=rows[v['n']]['text']
    vals=re.findall(r'=\$?("[^"]*"|[^ \n]+)',s)
    toks=[]
    for x in vals:
        x=x.strip('"').lower()
        if x.startswith('$'): continue
        toks.extend(re.findall(r"[A-Za-z0-9:>\-'’\.]+",x))
    tw=[w for w in words(t) if w not in ('.',',',':',';','?','!','-','>','->')]
    tw2=[w.strip('.') for w in tw]
    c1=collections.Counter(toks); c2=collections.Counter(tw2)
    missing=[w for w in c2 if c1[w]<c2[w] and w not in ('n\'t',)]
    extra=[w for w in c1 if c1[w]>c2[w]]
    if missing or extra:
        print("COVER n",v['n'],"missing",missing[:8],"extra",extra[:8])
